LanguageData.KCJ_BlameShiftEffect.label: Empty Fort — Blame Shift
LanguageData.KCJ_BlameShiftEffect.description: If the "Empty Fort" is exposed, hold this ritual within 4 hours to stop the retaliatory raid. Holding it within 24 hours can still restore 70% (adjustable) of the exposure relation penalty. Banish a "Full Employee" (colonist) or "Intern" (slave) during the ritual.
